snippet.title: Clive Barker's Hellraiser Revival - Galaxies Showcase Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

This is the first video game set in the Hellraiser universe. Clive Barker worked on its new story, and Doug Bradley returns as the voice of Pinhead. You descend into Hell to rescue your love from the Cenobites, using the Genesis Configuration puzzle box alongside earthly weapons. It launches October 8, 2026, on PS5, Xbox Series and PC
